stage.description: Static analysis (SAST) with Semgrep — scans the session worktree for security findings

artifacts.description: Semgrep JSON + SARIF reports and scan log

nextSteps: pipx install semgrep   # or: pip install semgrep / brew install semgrep
Open .har/artifacts/sast/ for the JSON and SARIF reports
Read .har/stages/SEMGREP.md to pin rulesets (HARNESS_SEMGREP_CONFIG) or add local rules
CI: set the SEMGREP_APP_TOKEN secret so semgrep ci reports to the Semgrep AppSec Platform (compliance evidence, e.g. Vanta)
